text:
### Monitoring Methods  
**Automated Rules (Fraud Detection Engine, see [[systems]]):**  
| Rule | Threshold | Action |
|------|-----------|--------|
| Large deposit | >£50,000 in 24h | Alert + manual review |
| Rapid movement | Deposit then withdrawal <2h | Alert for review |
| Multiple small transfers | 10+ transfers to different recipients <24h | Velocity alert |
| Geographic anomaly | Transaction in different country within 2 hours | Alert for review |
| High-risk jurisdiction | Transaction with sanctioned country | Auto-block |
| Unusual beneficiary | Transfer to new beneficiary >threshold | Alert for review |  
**Manual Monitoring:**
- Financial Crime team reviews alerts
- Pattern analysis for suspicious sequences
- Behavioral profiling changes
- Judgment-based assessment

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection Engine
raw_entities.description: An automated system that monitors customer transactions against predefined rules to detect potential fraud. The engine generates alerts for large deposits, rapid movements, velocity patterns, geographic anomalies, high-risk jurisdictions, and unusual beneficiaries, triggering manual review or automatic blocking actions.
context: Automated Rules (Fraud Detection Engine, see [[systems]]):
Large deposit | >£50,000 in 24h | Alert + manual review
High-risk jurisdiction | Transaction with sanctioned country | Auto-block

raw_entities.name: Large Deposit Alert
raw_entities.description: An automated monitoring rule that triggers an alert and manual review when a deposit exceeds £50,000 within a 24-hour period. This control is designed to identify potentially suspicious high-value deposit activity.
context: Large deposit | >£50,000 in 24h | Alert + manual review

raw_entities.name: Rapid Movement Alert
raw_entities.description: An automated monitoring rule that flags transactions where a deposit is followed by a withdrawal within less than 2 hours. This control detects potential layering or rapid fund movement patterns indicative of money laundering.
context: Rapid movement | Deposit then withdrawal <2h | Alert for review

raw_entities.name: Velocity Alert
raw_entities.description: An automated monitoring rule that generates a velocity alert when 10 or more transfers to different recipients occur within a 24-hour period. This control identifies potential structuring or rapid distribution patterns.
context: Multiple small transfers | 10+ transfers to different recipients <24h | Velocity alert

raw_entities.name: Geographic Anomaly Alert
raw_entities.description: An automated monitoring rule that triggers an alert for manual review when a transaction occurs in a different country within 2 hours of a previous transaction. This control detects geographically impossible or suspicious transaction patterns.
context: Geographic anomaly | Transaction in different country within 2 hours | Alert for review

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Jurisdiction Block
raw_entities.description: An automated control that automatically blocks transactions involving sanctioned countries or high-risk jurisdictions. This is a preventive measure that stops transactions before they complete rather than generating an alert.
context: High-risk jurisdiction | Transaction with sanctioned country | Auto-block

raw_entities.name: Unusual Beneficiary Alert
raw_entities.description: An automated monitoring rule that triggers an alert for manual review when a transfer is made to a new beneficiary above a defined threshold. This control identifies transfers to previously unknown recipients that may warrant additional scrutiny.
context: Unusual beneficiary | Transfer to new beneficiary >threshold | Alert for review

raw_entities.name: Manual Alert Review
raw_entities.description: A manual monitoring process performed by the Financial Crime team to review alerts generated by the automated fraud detection engine. The team conducts pattern analysis, behavioral profiling, and judgment-based assessment of suspicious activity.
context: Financial Crime team reviews alerts
Pattern analysis for suspicious sequences
Behavioral profiling changes
Judgment-based assessment

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime Team
raw_entities.description: The team responsible for reviewing fraud detection alerts, conducting pattern analysis for suspicious sequences, assessing behavioral profiling changes, and making judgment-based assessments of flagged transactions.
context: Financial Crime team reviews alerts
Pattern analysis for suspicious sequences
Behavioral profiling changes

raw_entities.name: Large Deposit Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk that unusually large deposits (exceeding £50,000 in 24 hours) may indicate money laundering, fraud, or other financial crime activity requiring investigation.
context: Large deposit | >£50,000 in 24h | Alert + manual review

raw_entities.name: Rapid Fund Movement Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk that deposits followed immediately by withdrawals (within 2 hours) may indicate layering or rapid fund movement consistent with money laundering schemes.
context: Rapid movement | Deposit then withdrawal <2h | Alert for review

raw_entities.name: Structuring Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk that multiple small transfers to different recipients within a short timeframe (10+ transfers in 24 hours) may indicate structuring or deliberate fragmentation of funds to evade detection.
context: Multiple small transfers | 10+ transfers to different recipients <24h | Velocity alert

raw_entities.name: Geographic Anomaly Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk that transactions occurring in geographically distant locations within an impossibly short timeframe (2 hours) may indicate account compromise, fraud, or unauthorized access.
context: Geographic anomaly | Transaction in different country within 2 hours | Alert for review

raw_entities.name: Sanctions Violation Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk that transactions with sanctioned countries or high-risk jurisdictions may violate sanctions regulations and expose the bank to regulatory penalties and reputational harm.
context: High-risk jurisdiction | Transaction with sanctioned country | Auto-block

raw_entities.name: Unusual Beneficiary Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk that transfers to new or previously unknown beneficiaries above a defined threshold may indicate account compromise, fraud, or unauthorized fund diversion.
context: Unusual beneficiary | Transfer to new beneficiary >threshold | Alert for review
